scope: Observed AB07 V26C best47 exploratory zero-shot transfer compared with the same-reset prescribed AB07 prefix; AB06 is descriptive only
physical_horizon_authority: Native OpenSim state time when captured, otherwise native runner time, otherwise explicitly limited to the logical environment time. A terminal guard sample is separate evidence.

clock_reset_features.comparison_note: Learned clock-off convention remains (0,1); prescribed phase clock is an explicit control-contract difference.

methodology.tolerance_scope: Historical AB06 binary development and analog holdout diagnostic references; not new AB07 acceptance gates
methodology.startup: Unanchored partial actor stance is separate from anchored valid stance; complete-cycle oracle excludes unanchored initial TO; force-threshold crossings are a separate channel
methodology.comparison_window: Prescribed is cropped to the actual learned observation horizon. If learned ends early, no future prescribed data are counted as the matched window. Planned nominal coverage is retained separately.

force_1ms_matched_window.method: Trapezoid on matched saved 1 ms STO timestamps; reference GRF interpolated from measured data. No extrapolation or missing terminal sample is invented.

phase_and_events.interpretation: The historical acceptance journal preserves subsequently revoked HS; the retained-after-repairs matching and final counters are separate. HS cancellation records are repairs rather than physiological zero-duration stances. Actor-valid cycles remain distinct from binary events and agreement with measured contact; an unanchored startup TO remains an explicit extra against the complete-cycle oracle.

saved_policy_boundaries.morphology_interpretation: Saved reward diagnostics use their own configurations; the learned policy retains its frozen AB06 corridor. They are not an independent AB07 morphology acceptance measure.

AB06_descriptive_reference.note: Different subject, trial and event-relative reset; exact reproduction of historical AB06 does not establish AB07 transfer quality.

limitations: No policy inference, simulator integration, new detector run, saved-pose replay or reward reconstruction is performed.

The prescribed run uses raw IK actions; best47 uses normalized absolute actions with clock disabled and no privileged target inputs in the actor. The intervention changes this control contract; a difference cannot be uniquely attributed to network weights.
The exploratory AB07 start offset 0 differs from the training/AB06 central offset 1.956870983805102; this is not a matched-phase cross-subject test.

1 ms STO physical statistics use pre-integration samples through episode_end minus integration_dt. Earlier 9.01 s qualification impulse used post-step 10 ms boundaries; values across these horizons/time bases are not interchangeable.
Saved binary data are reported only if present. Analog 10 ms heel/toe contacts are not used to invent binary events or 1 ms boolean occupancy.
Reference cycle timing includes measured nominal events; internal valid cycle count alone does not validate gait physiology or autonomy.
Raw IK, served reference and actual trajectories are separate quantities. The frozen AB06 morphology corridor is a reward prior, not a new subject-specific target or acceptance criterion.
Recruitment norms contain mixed generalized force units; they are comparative diagnostics, not direct scalar joint torque or muscle adequacy certification.
Returned reward of a prescribed imitation configuration is not compared to the ex-novo learned return, and cross-subject return is not an autonomous qualification score.
